comment: CC0 third-party asset packs. The asset-fetch workflow downloads each pack on a CI runner (the dev sandbox has no outbound internet), extracts the models AND the textures they reference, writes a LICENSE.txt beside them, and commits the result to game/assets/thirdparty/<name>/. Keeping only *.glb was a mistake: the pirate kit's models referenced Textures/colormap.png, which produced 72 import errors per CI run for assets nothing used. Game code must ALWAYS keep a procedural fallback: assets are dressing, never a dependency (docs/11 section 6).

packs.name: nature-kit
packs.why: bare trees, rocks, fence pieces, stone-wall segments for New England fields (Battle Road cover set will build on these)
